title: What they say when work has broken them
end_big: What do you say after work?
tag: Check in on each other in CoupleIn
items: My brain is full. Give me ten minutes, then ask again.
I'm overwhelmed and don't want to snap at you.
I'm struggling and too proud to say.
Sit near me. Just don't ask me anything.
I've got nothing left tonight. It's not you.
